The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has been remade for the Nintendo Switch 2 - and it's incredible. In this episode, the core-four reminisce about their experience with the Zelda series before the hugely important "Zelda 64" arrived in 1998. From there, they get into their thoughts on the game and how it pushed video games forward. Beyond that, they briefly touch on Nintendo 3DS remaster before finally tackling the 2026 remake.
